method: NASA source page text reviewed through a web research tool; credit/PIA/date fields crosschecked against displayed page metadata. This is an editorial preflight, not independent image-rights clearance or personal human link check.

policy.finding: NASA generally has no objection to certain informational uses, subject to rules covering third-party copyright, identifiable individuals, NASA symbols, and implied endorsement. No individual photograph is cleared by this audit.

prohibitions: No NASA image binaries embedded or reproduced in public site
No inferred geographic coordinates, evidentiary map edges, or event chronology from photograph dates
No individual rights approval, endorsement, or license inferred from NASA credit or producer
Any change to crosswalk catalog/URL requires fresh source verification and review
